title: VIAS: Value-Isolating Activation Steering for Multi-Value Alignment and Compliance for Organisations
title_zh: VIAS：面向组织多价值对齐与合规的价值隔离激活引导

paragraphs.en: Organisations increasingly deploy large language model agents that must follow organisational values. We check whether activation steering, which adds vectors to a model’s internal activations during generation without changing its weights, can improve compliance beyond prompting alone. Since most scenarios involve several values at once, we focus on multi-value steering. A simple way to build these vectors is to contrast responses that follow all values relevant to a scenario with responses that violate them. However, this gives nearly identical vectors for different values: they capture a general compliance signal rather than individual values, which limits their use when combining several values. We propose Value-Isolating Activation Steering (VIAS), which contrasts responses to the same scenario under two prompts, one listing all relevant values and one omitting a single target value. We keep a pair only if the target value changes from compliant to non-compliant and both responses still meet a minimum compliance level on the other values. We evaluate VIAS on PROTECT, a workplace compliance dataset where each scenario is tagged with relevant values from a 21-value taxonomy. VIAS reduces overlap between value vectors, making them better suited for multi-value steering, although this alone does not lead to independent control over each value. Combined with prompting, VIAS complies with every tagged value on 69.6% of scenarios for Qwen2.5-7B, 75.2% for Mistral-7B, and 72.6% for Phi-3.5-mini, outperforming prompting alone for all three models.
paragraphs.zh: 各组织越来越多地部署必须遵循组织价值观的大语言模型智能体。 我们检验激活引导（activation steering）——即在生成过程中向模型内部激活添加向量而不改变其权重——能否在仅使用提示之外进一步改善合规性。 由于大多数场景同时涉及多个价值观，我们专注于多价值观引导。 构建这些向量的一种简单方法，是将遵循某场景所有相关价值观的回答与违反这些价值观的回答进行对比。 然而，这会为不同价值观得到几乎相同的向量：它们捕捉到的是一种一般性的合规信号而非各个价值观本身，这限制了它们在组合多个价值观时的使用。 我们提出价值观分离激活引导（Value-Isolating Activation Steering, VIAS），其做法是在两种提示下对同一场景的回答进行对比：一种提示列出所有相关价值观，另一种提示省略单个目标价值观。 我们仅保留满足以下条件的回答对：目标价值观从合规变为不合规，且两个回答在其他价值观上仍达到最低合规水平。 我们在 PROTECT 上评估 VIAS，这是一个职场合规数据集，其中每个场景都依据包含 21 种价值观的分类体系标注了相关价值观。 VIAS 减少了价值观向量之间的重叠，使其更适合多价值观引导，尽管仅凭这一点并不能实现对每个价值观的独立控制。 结合提示使用时，VIAS 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上于 69.6% 的场景对所有标注价值观合规，在 Mistral-7B 上为 75.2%，在 Phi-3.5-mini 上为 72.6%，在全部三个模型上都优于仅使用提示。

paragraphs.en: Organizations increasingly deploy large language model agents both for their own employees and for outside users, such as customer support bots, coding assistants, and other user-facing tools. Because these systems act on behalf of the organization, they must follow its code of conduct and policies. Such policies can be expressed as organizational values, and the PROTECT taxonomy ( Mittal et al., 2025 ) organizes them into a structured set of 21 values that a compliant system should follow.
paragraphs.zh: 各组织日益为其内部员工和外部用户部署大型语言模型智能体，例如客服机器人、编程助手以及其他面向用户的工具。 由于这些系统代表组织行事，它们必须遵守组织的行为准则和政策。 这些政策可以被表述为组织价值观，而 PROTECT 分类法（Mittal et al., 2025）将其整理为一套结构化的 21 项价值观，供合规系统遵循。

sents.en: Organizations increasingly deploy large language model agents both for their own employees and for outside users, such as customer support bots, coding assistants, and other user-facing tools.

sents.en: Such policies can be expressed as organizational values, and the PROTECT taxonomy ( Mittal et al., 2025 ) organizes them into a structured set of 21 values that a compliant system should follow.
sents.zh: 这些政策可以被表述为组织价值观，而 PROTECT 分类法（Mittal et al., 2025）将其整理为一套结构化的 21 项价值观，供合规系统遵循。

paragraphs.en: Unlike organizational taxonomies, general-purpose human value taxonomies such as Schwartz’s ( Schwartz, 2012 ) and Rokeach’s ( Rokeach, 1973 ) are broad and not tailored to any single organization. Two common ways to make a model follow a chosen set of values are to describe them in the prompt ( Palla et al., 2025 ) or to build a dataset and fine-tune the model ( Zhu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Prompts tell the model which values to follow, but they do not guarantee compliance. We study whether activation steering can help the model follow these instructions more reliably, without fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 与组织分类法不同，Schwartz（Schwartz, 2012）和Rokeach（Rokeach, 1973）等人提出的通用人类价值分类法内容宽泛，并非针对任何单一组织定制。 让模型遵循一组选定价值观的两种常见方法是：在提示词中描述这些价值观（Palla et al., 2025），或者构建数据集并对模型进行微调（Zhu et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2025）。 提示词告诉模型应遵循哪些价值观，但并不能保证模型切实遵从。 我们研究激活引导能否在不进行微调的情况下，帮助模型更可靠地遵循这些指令。

paragraphs.en: Activation steering adds a fixed vector to a model’s internal activations at inference time to shift its behavior ( Turner et al., 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Zou and others, 2023 ) . We evaluate steering with and without value-specific prompts. Prior work studies both single- and multi-behavior steering ( van der Weij et al., 2024 ) ; here we focus on the contrastive examples used for overlapping organizational values. A PROTECT scenario usually engages several overlapping values from its 21-value taxonomy, such as Innovation and Confidentiality. Compliance requires upholding that scenario’s tagged subset, not all 21 values in every scenario. We keep the method for computing and applying activation vectors unchanged. Instead, we use value-isolating prompts to create the contrastive pairs. Figure 1 gives an overview of the approach. This paper makes three contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 激活引导在推理时向模型内部激活添加固定向量以改变其行为（Turner 等，2023；Rimsky 等，2024；Zou 等，2023）。 我们在使用与不使用价值特定提示词两种情况下评估引导效果。 已有研究同时考察单行为与多行为引导（van der Weij 等，2024）；本文聚焦于用于重叠组织价值观的对比样本。 一个 PROTECT 场景通常会涉及其 21 项价值观分类体系中多个相互重叠的价值观，例如创新与保密。 合规要求遵守该场景所标注的价值观子集，而非在每个场景中都遵守全部 21 项价值观。 我们保持计算与应用激活向量的方法不变。 相反，我们使用价值隔离提示词来构建对比样本对。 图 1 给出了该方法的概览。 本文做出三项贡献。

paragraphs.en: We propose Value-Isolating Activation Steering (VIAS) , a contrastive data construction that varies one value at a time while holding the rest of the scenario fixed. Where all-values contrasts yield highly collinear per-value vectors, VIAS reduces their collinearity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出价值隔离激活导向（Value-Isolating Activation Steering, VIAS），一种对比式数据构建方法：每次只改变一个价值，同时保持场景的其余部分不变。 当所有价值的对比会产生高度共线的逐价值向量时，VIAS 能降低它们的共线性。

sents.en: We propose Value-Isolating Activation Steering (VIAS) , a contrastive data construction that varies one value at a time while holding the rest of the scenario fixed.
sents.zh: 我们提出价值隔离激活导向（Value-Isolating Activation Steering, VIAS），一种对比式数据构建方法：每次只改变一个价值，同时保持场景的其余部分不变。

sents.en: Where all-values contrasts yield highly collinear per-value vectors, VIAS reduces their collinearity.
sents.zh: 当所有价值的对比会产生高度共线的逐价值向量时，VIAS 能降低它们的共线性。

paragraphs.en: We diagnose why direct activation steering falls short. With all-values contrasts or synthetic per-value data, the directions align with a shared comply-versus-violate axis, limiting value-specific steering.
paragraphs.zh: 我们诊断了直接激活转向为何效果不佳。 使用全值对比或合成的逐值数据时，这些方向会对齐到一个共享的服从与违规轴上，从而限制了针对特定价值的转向。

paragraphs.en: We find that VIAS combined with a values-prompt scores higher than prompting alone in the evaluated models. A weighted variant that combines the per-value directions by reliability reaches similar compliance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，在所评估的模型中，VIAS 结合价值观提示的得分高于仅使用提示。 一种按可靠性对各价值观方向进行加权的变体达到了相近的符合度。

paragraphs.en: Schwartz’s basic values ( Schwartz, 2012 ) motivate similar taxonomies for organisations. PROTECT ( Mittal et al., 2025 ) defines 21 values in six subgroups and builds on BeaverTails ( Ji and others, 2023 ) to generate 15,000 training and 3,200 test scenarios, each tagged with relevant values and paired with compliant and non-compliant responses.
paragraphs.zh: Schwartz 的基本价值观（Schwartz，2012）为组织提供了类似的分类框架。 PROTECT（Mittal 等，2025）在六个子组中定义了 21 种价值观，并基于 BeaverTails（Ji 等，2023）生成了 15,000 个训练场景和 3,200 个测试场景，每个场景都标注了相关价值观，并配有合规与不合规的回应。

sents.en: Schwartz’s basic values ( Schwartz, 2012 ) motivate similar taxonomies for organisations.
sents.zh: Schwartz 的基本价值观（Schwartz，2012）为组织提供了类似的分类框架。

sents.en: PROTECT ( Mittal et al., 2025 ) defines 21 values in six subgroups and builds on BeaverTails ( Ji and others, 2023 ) to generate 15,000 training and 3,200 test scenarios, each tagged with relevant values and paired with compliant and non-compliant responses.
sents.zh: PROTECT（Mittal 等，2025）在六个子组中定义了 21 种价值观，并基于 BeaverTails（Ji 等，2023）生成了 15,000 个训练场景和 3,200 个测试场景，每个场景都标注了相关价值观，并配有合规与不合规的回应。

paragraphs.en: Early work controls generation by adding fixed vectors to hidden states ( Subramani et al., 2022 ) , while Activation Addition edits activations to change behaviour ( Turner et al., 2023 ) . Representation Engineering monitors and manipulates high-level representations ( Zou and others, 2023 ) . Inference-Time Intervention shifts attention-head activations along truthful directions ( Li et al., 2023 ) ; refusal in chat models can be traced to a single residual-stream direction ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) . Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ) averages answer-token activation differences between matched multiple-choice prompts with opposite answer letters. Persona Vectors ( Chen et al., 2025 ) use generated trait-specific examples, scored responses, and response-token averages. Other methods optimise vectors on preference pairs ( Cao et al., 2024 ) or steer only inputs that match a condition ( Lee et al., 2025 ) . Effects vary widely across inputs and can break under small prompt changes ( Tan et al., 2024 ) . Work on Schwartz values extracts steering vectors ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2025 ) and tests whether they preserve the circumplex structure ( Abootorabi et al., 2026 ) . We adapt these ideas to organisational values rather than reproduce one pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 早期工作通过向隐藏状态添加固定向量来控制生成（Subramani et al., 2022），而 Activation Addition 通过编辑激活来改变行为（Turner et al., 2023）。 Representation Engineering 监控并操纵高层表示（Zou and others, 2023）。 Inference-Time Intervention 沿真实方向平移注意力头激活（Li et al., 2023）；对话模型中的拒答可追溯至残差流中的单一方向（Arditi et al., 2024）。 对比激活加法（CAA）（Rimsky et al., 2024）对答案字母相反的匹配多项选择提示之间在答案词元位置的激活差异取平均。 Persona Vectors（Chen et al., 2025）使用生成的特质相关示例、经评分的回答以及回答词元的平均值。 其他方法在偏好对上优化向量（Cao et al., 2024），或仅对满足特定条件的输入进行导向（Lee et al., 2025）。 效果在不同输入间差异很大，且在提示发生微小变化时可能失效（Tan et al., 2024）。 关于 Schwartz 价值观的工作提取导向向量（Jin et al., 2025；Han et al., 2025），并检验这些向量是否保持了环形结构（Abootorabi et al., 2026）。 我们将这些思想适配到组织价值观上，而非复现某一条流水线。

paragraphs.en: van der Weij et al. (2024) compare single-layer vector combination with simultaneous injections at different layers in Llama 2-7B-Chat, finding the latter more promising. Simple addition can combine a small number of targets, including instruction vectors for format, length, and word constraints ( Stolfo et al., 2025 ) and preference-optimised behaviour vectors ( Cao et al., 2024 ) . To address interference or fluency loss from naive sums, Dynamic Activation Composition adjusts property strengths during generation ( Scalena et al., 2024 ) ; conceptors use Boolean operations and outperform addition on several tasks ( Postmus and Abreu, 2024 ) ; and CONFST builds one confident direction for more than two preferences ( Song et al., 2025 ) . Trained approaches include MAT-Steer, which learns attribute vectors with orthogonality constraints and token selection ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ) ; MSRS, which assigns attribute-specific and shared subspaces ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) ; and K-Steering, which replaces per-attribute vectors with gradients from one non-linear multi-label classifier ( Oozeer et al., 2025 ) . Training-free methods rotate activations within a joint attribute subspace to avoid norm imbalance and cancellation ( Ghasemi et al., 2026 ) , or compose existing vectors for new tasks ( Han et al., 2026 ) . Steering one value can also shift related values ( Abootorabi et al., 2026 ) . These methods mainly change how and where vectors are combined; we study how response-pair construction affects directions for multiple overlapping values and their joint compliance.

paragraphs.en: For each training scenario we generate one complying response, under a system prompt that lists all of the scenario’s tagged values and asks the model to uphold them, and one violating response, under a prompt that asks the model to disregard the same values. We test both lenient and strict extraction prompts for All-values, whereas Persyn and VIAS use only lenient prompts (Table 2 ; templates in Appendix A ). A per-value direction uses pairs tagged with that value whose positive response is judged compliant and negative response violating. These overlapping subsets can reuse the same response pair, encouraging shared components without implying that the values themselves are identical. We call this construction All-values .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个训练场景，我们在一个列出该场景所有标记值并要求模型遵守这些值的系统提示下，生成一个符合要求的回答，并在一个要求模型无视相同值的提示下，生成一个违反要求的回答。 针对 All-values，我们同时测试了宽松和严格的提取提示，而 Persyn 和 VIAS 仅使用宽松提示（表 2；模板见附录 A）。 单值方向（per-value direction）使用带有该值标记的回答对，其中正向回答被判定为合规，负向回答被判定为违规。 这些相互重叠的子集可以复用相同的回答对，从而在不暗示这些值本身相同的情况下，鼓励共享的成分。 我们将这种构造称为 All-values。

paragraphs.en: Our main metric is strict sample compliance : the fraction of scenarios in which every tagged value is judged compliant. Per-value compliance is the fraction of scenarios tagged with a given value that comply with it. Micro compliance is the fraction of all scenario–value pairs judged compliant; macro compliance averages the per-value rates, giving each of the 21 values equal weight.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要指标是严格样本合规率：即每个被标注的值都被判定为合规的场景所占的比例。 单值合规率是指被标注为某个给定值的场景中符合该值的比例。 微观合规率是所有「场景–值」对中被判定合规的比例；宏观合规率则对各单值合规率取平均，使 21 个值中的每个值权重相等。

paragraphs.en: Hard-subset recovery is the fraction of scenario–value pairs judged violating or unclear under the baseline that become compliant under a method. For these measures, steering methods use the original baseline, while SFT uses its separately evaluated base model (Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 难子集恢复率（Hard-subset recovery）是指在基线下被判定为违规或不明确的场景–取值对中，在某种方法下变为合规的比例。 易子集保留率（Easy-subset retention）是指在基线下合规的对中仍然保持合规的比例。 对于这些指标，转向方法使用原始基线，而 SFT 使用其单独评估的基座模型（附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: Raw VIAS+VP reaches 69.6 % 69.6\% , 75.2 % 75.2\% , and 72.6 % 72.6\% on Qwen, Mistral, and Phi, respectively, above VP alone on all three models. In the reported paired-bootstrap tests, the gains over VP are not statistically significant on Qwen ( p = .108 p=.108 ) or Mistral ( p = .054 p=.054 ; Appendix C ). Phi also scores above its unprompted baseline, so its gain is not simply a recovery from the decline under VP. Phi’s gain also depends on the steering layer: VIAS+VP helps at L16 but not at the probe-optimal L27. Why Phi gains more remains unclear. Weighted VIAS+VP gives Mistral’s highest strict compliance in Table 1 ( 75.5 % 75.5\% ), but scores below raw VIAS+VP on Qwen and Phi. It also gives the highest macro compliance on Qwen and Mistral. On Qwen, raw VIAS+VP raises strict compliance over VP alone, while micro compliance is unchanged at the reported precision. Both VIAS variants score higher than their corresponding Persyn variants with VP.

paragraphs.en: Activation steering struggles when a model must follow several organizational values at once. When contrastive pairs ask the model to follow or break all of a scenario’s values together, the resulting per-value directions are nearly identical. Changing how these directions were weighted or combined did not consistently improve compliance in the tested configurations. We therefore proposed Value-Isolating Activation Steering (VIAS), which builds pairs that differ in only one value. This makes the directions much less similar, though not fully independent. On its own, VIAS scores below prompting on Qwen and Mistral and above it on Phi. Combined with prompting, it gives the highest compliance we observed on all three models.

paragraphs.en: VIAS also depends on how the data is built. Steering is single-layer and coherence-gated, so we report what fluency-preserving steering achieves rather than the strongest possible push. SFT uses a single training seed and reuses development and test data examined in earlier experiments. SFT with a values-prompt is not evaluated, and the second-judge and human checks do not cover the new SFT outputs. Our study spans three 3.8 3.8 – 7 7 B instruction-tuned models and one taxonomy, and the collinearity we measure at the steering layer may differ for other models or layers. paragraphs.en: Even the best configuration leaves about a quarter of scenarios with a value judged non-compliant, so VIAS shifts a distribution of behaviour rather than enforcing anything and is no substitute for human review or governance. PROTECT’s 21 values also encode one English-language, corporate view of appropriate conduct, and reweighting is value-neutral machinery: what an operator steers toward remains a governance question outside this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 即使是最优的配置，仍有约四分之一的场景中的价值被判定为不合规，因此 VIAS 只是对行为分布进行调整，而非强制执行任何东西，无法替代人工审查或治理。 PROTECT 的 21 项价值也只编码了一种英语的、企业视角的适当行为观，而重新加权只是价值中立的机制：操作者将系统引向何方，仍是本文范围之外的治理问题。

paragraphs.en: Figures 10 – 15 show six test scenarios, two per model, in which VIAS+VP complies on every tagged value and the values-prompt alone does not. Each figure gives the judge label for every tagged value under the eight settings of Table 1 ( ✓ \checkmark complies, ? unclear, × \times violates; All-val. is All-values) and excerpts of the VP and VIAS+VP responses to the same scenario. Excerpts are verbatim except that Markdown is rendered and omitted text is marked […]; highlighted text is the passage that addresses the value VP misses. We selected these examples by hand from the scenarios where VIAS+VP complies and VP does not ( 77 77 on Qwen, 98 98 on Mistral, 155 155 on Phi; the reverse holds for 59 59 , 73 73 , and 58 58 ), reading both full responses and discarding cases where the difference came from the 256 256 -token cap (Appendix B ) or an evident judge error. They illustrate the most common pattern rather than average behavior. In each example, the VP response handles the scenario sensibly but leaves one tagged value unaddressed, and VIAS+VP addresses it explicitly. Across all such scenarios, the value recovered most often is Innovation on all three models, the lowest-compliance value at baseline (Figure 2 ).

sents.en: Figures 10 – 15 show six test scenarios, two per model, in which VIAS+VP complies on every tagged value and the values-prompt alone does not.
sents.zh: 图 10–15 展示了六个测试场景（每个模型两个），在这些场景中 VIAS+VP 在每个标注值上都合规，而仅使用值提示（values-prompt）则不合规。

sents.en: Each figure gives the judge label for every tagged value under the eight settings of Table 1 ( ✓ \checkmark complies, ? unclear, × \times violates; All-val. is All-values) and excerpts of the VP and VIAS+VP responses to the same scenario.
sents.zh: 每幅图给出了表 1 的八种设置下每个标注值的评判标签（✓ 合规，? 不明确，× 违规；All-val. 即 All-values），以及针对同一场景的 VP 和 VIAS+VP 回复的节选。

sents.en: Excerpts are verbatim except that Markdown is rendered and omitted text is marked […]; highlighted text is the passage that addresses the value VP misses.
sents.zh: 节选为逐字引用，但 Markdown 已被渲染，省略的文本以 […] 标注；高亮的文本是针对 VP 遗漏的那个值的段落。

sents.en: We selected these examples by hand from the scenarios where VIAS+VP complies and VP does not ( 77 77 on Qwen, 98 98 on Mistral, 155 155 on Phi; the reverse holds for 59 59 , 73 73 , and 58 58 ), reading both full responses and discarding cases where the difference came from the 256 256 -token cap (Appendix B ) or an evident judge error.
sents.zh: 我们从 VIAS+VP 合规而 VP 不合规的场景中手工挑选了这些示例（Qwen 上有 77 个，Mistral 上有 98 个，Phi 上有 155 个；反向情况分别为 59 个、73 个和 58 个），阅读了两份完整回复，并剔除了差异源自 256 token 上限（附录 B）或明显评判错误的情形。

sents.en: They illustrate the most common pattern rather than average behavior.
sents.zh: 这些示例展示的是最常见的模式，而非平均行为。

sents.en: In each example, the VP response handles the scenario sensibly but leaves one tagged value unaddressed, and VIAS+VP addresses it explicitly.
sents.zh: 在每个示例中，VP 的回复对场景的处理合理但遗漏了一个标注值，而 VIAS+VP 则明确地处理了该值。

sents.en: Across all such scenarios, the value recovered most often is Innovation on all three models, the lowest-compliance value at baseline (Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: 在所有此类场景中，恢复频率最高的值是创新性（Innovation），它在三个模型上都是基线合规率最低的值（图 2）。
